description: Navigate back in the app or through system navigation. Use in-app for the app navigation stack and system when the platform back behavior is required. On iOS both modes swipe from the left edge and succeed only when the app screen changes. Reason back_swipe_no_change: the swipe was sent and the screen did not change; press the visible back or close control. Reason back_swipe_unverified: the swipe may or may not have navigated, because the screen kept changing before it or could not be sampled after it; check with snapshot. Reason back_swipe_not_dispatched, or a screen that cannot be sampled before the swipe, means nothing was sent. An app with a left-edge drawer may open the drawer instead. Press a visible back or close control by its ref directly. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

settleQuietMs.description: Settle: quiet window in milliseconds (default 500; 300 on the iOS simulator snapshot bridge). On iOS, a broad replacement of a non-empty screen holds at least 1500ms within timeoutMs.

name: back
